import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))

# Create subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))

# 1. Income distribution by education level
income_edu_ax = axes[0, 0]
edu_order = ['Basic', 'Graduation', 'Master', 'PhD']
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='Education', y='Income', order=edu_order, ax=income_edu_ax, palette='Set2')
income_edu_ax.set_title('Income Distribution by Education Level', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
income_edu_ax.set_xlabel('Education Level', fontsize=12)
income_edu_ax.set_ylabel('Income ($)', fontsize=12)
income_edu_ax.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 2. Spending patterns across product categories
spending_ax = axes[0, 1]
spending_cols = ['MntWines', 'MntFruits', 'MntMeatProducts', 'MntFishProducts', 'MntSweetProducts', 'MntGoldProds']
spending_data = df[spending_cols].mean().sort_values(ascending=False)
spending_labels = ['Wines', 'Fruits', 'Meat', 'Fish', 'Sweets', 'Gold']
bars = spending_ax.bar(range(len(spending_data)), spending_data.values, color=plt.cm.Set3(np.arange(len(spending_data))))
spending_ax.set_title('Average Spending by Product Category', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
spending_ax.set_xlabel('Product Category', fontsize=12)
spending_ax.set_ylabel('Average Amount Spent ($)', fontsize=12)
spending_ax.set_xticks(range(len(spending_data)))
spending_ax.set_xticklabels(spending_labels, rotation=45, ha='right')
for i, v in enumerate(spending_data.values):
    spending_ax.text(i, v + 50, f'${v:.0f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=10)

# 3. Purchase channels comparison
purchase_ax = axes[1, 0]
purchase_cols = ['NumWebPurchases', 'NumCatalogPurchases', 'NumStorePurchases']
purchase_data = df[purchase_cols].mean()
purchase_labels = ['Web Purchases', 'Catalog Purchases', 'Store Purchases']
colors = ['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4', '#45B7D1']
wedges, texts, autotexts = purchase_ax.pie(purchase_data, labels=purchase_labels, colors=colors, autopct='%1.1f%%', 
                                          startangle=90, textprops={'fontsize': 11})
purchase_ax.set_title('Distribution of Purchase Channels', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')

# 4. Customer demographics: Marital status distribution
marital_ax = axes[1, 1]
marital_counts = df['Marital_Status'].value_counts()
marital_labels = marital_counts.index
marital_colors = plt.cm.Pastel1(np.arange(len(marital_labels)))
bars = marital_ax.barh(range(len(marital_counts)), marital_counts.values, color=marital_colors)
marital_ax.set_title('Customer Distribution by Marital Status', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
marital_ax.set_xlabel('Number of Customers', fontsize=12)
marital_ax.set_yticks(range(len(marital_counts)))
marital_ax.set_yticklabels(marital_labels, fontsize=11)
for i, v in enumerate(marital_counts.values):
    marital_ax.text(v + 20, i, str(v), va='center', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# Adjust layout and save
plt.suptitle('Customer Segmentation Analysis: Demographics, Spending & Behavior', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
plt.close()
